title: Public-API 3-Pair MisGAN on 4-Mode 8D Block-Masked Data
intuition: Compact public-API MisGAN learning a 4-mode distribution embedded in 8D and its block sensor-dropout mask law strictly from incomplete observations, plus a stochastic neural imputer verified on held-out queries.
failure_mode: Leaking mask gradients into data generation or collapsing imputer uncertainty produces off-plane points or overwrites observed coordinates.
protocol_notes: Research diagnostic model-mode MisGAN task (4 modes on 8D Hadamard subspace).
